answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an umber bet on surviving 111 epochs of grading, and every timber settlement recomputes the falcon schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 111 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
